explication: Lyrion Music Server streams local and plugin-provided audio to networked players. This tree is a browser-interface slice, not the server runtime: it shows the player-control shell, browsing and search entry points, playlist interactions, and plugin features. The principal user flow is to choose a player, find or add music, and control playback. Shared controller wiring is visible in Main.js; backend behavior and most request paths are not sampled, so those connections are omitted. The README documents broader streaming capabilities that these files alone cannot trace.
